Asha: RCA published for the degraded routing incident yesterday: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2087654321-routing-degradation
Asha: Brief: a config drift in the smart-routing table caused ~12% of requests to be routed to an overloaded capacity class during a traffic spike. Incident window ~22m, backend retries mitigated errors but tail latency increased.
Asha: Doc includes timeline, config diff, and samples. Please review owners + actions.
Tom: Thanks. Who's taking the config-locking work?
Asha: Action items in the doc (section 3):
- Tom — implement config version pin + validation in the control plane, target 2026-04-07
- Rey — add synthetic traffic test simulating mixed-weight routing, target 2026-04-04
- Clara — update rollout checklist and add a preflight for routing table drift, target 2026-03-31
Asha: Also added a short customer-impact blurb for support and an ops checklist for future spikes.
Rey: I'll build the synthetic test and wire it into CI. Can someone paste the traffic curve we saw?
Clara: Pasted curve in doc. Proposing a one-hour canary window for routing changes and an automated rollback when error-rate >0.5%.
Tom: I'll start an RFC for config locking. Will include a migration plan and backout strategy.
PagerBot: Incident INC-8122 logged: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-8122
Rey: PR #1158 drafted for the synthetic test, linking to the RCA now.
Clara: Scheduling a 15-min sync Friday 11:00 PT to review PRs and sign off on canary parameters. Invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/routing-check
Asha: Thanks everyone. Please ack in the doc when your action is complete. :thumbsup:
